registry_policy: Metadata and reviewed-pattern evidence only; no automatic clone, installation, execution, update, dependency import, Agent delegation, or authority inheritance.

sources.purpose: Canonical specialist Agent personas and review workflows.
sources.compatibility: Advisory guidance is compatible; definitions are not executable Skills.
sources.integration_model: Reference pinned Agent instructions through the advisory contract only.
sources.update_strategy: Review a new exact commit and quarantine changed Agent content before approval.
sources.risk_status: Prompt personas have no independent tool, shell, file-write, approval, or Host-execution authority.
validation_evidence: Repository metadata, license, current commit, README, and engineering-software-architect instructions inspected.

sources.purpose: Chinese localization and China-specific specialist Agent definitions.

sources.risk_status: Canonical English equivalents are deduplicated semantically; localized roles stay advisory-only.
validation_evidence: Repository metadata, license, current commit, README, and UPSTREAM.md inspected.
Local Agent inventory overlap measured without executing Agent definitions.

sources.purpose: Implementation examples plus selected offline Skill evaluation and security patterns.
sources.compatibility: Reviewed static and offline patterns are adaptable; complete applications are not production-ready Nexus dependencies.
sources.integration_model: Adapt small data-only validation patterns; do not import or execute applications.
sources.update_strategy: Review selected files at an exact commit; reject unbounded runtime, keys, unsafe flags, and shell assumptions.
sources.risk_status: Examples may require external models, keys, shell, broad permissions, or unsafe flags; no whole-repository import.
validation_evidence: README, agent_skills tree, relevant Skills, static scanner, and trigger evaluation script inspected.
Unsafe advisor and self-improving runtime paths explicitly rejected.

sources.purpose: Liquid Glass visual-effect implementation for React 18+ projects.

sources.risk_status: Frontend-only library with no Nexus runtime, Host handoff, Skill-routing, or Agent authority.

sources.purpose: Super-agent orchestration, Skill governance, permissions, validation, and subagent lifecycle patterns.
sources.compatibility: Selected data-contract and security patterns are adaptable; its runtime is outside the R5 boundary.
sources.integration_model: Adapt pure validation, permission, scanner, status, and bounded-runtime patterns without importing code.
sources.update_strategy: Review only relevant files at a new exact commit; never auto-install Skills or runtime dependencies.
sources.risk_status: Runtime requires subagents, sandbox/tool state, and install/update workflows outside the approved boundary.

sources.purpose: Official coding-agent runtime, protocol, sandbox, Skill, and plugin data models.

sources.purpose: Plugin-oriented agent harness with guarded execution and lifecycle seams.
